description: This PHP source file defines the class 'ConditionalFormattingRuleExtension' which extends the conditional formatting features for spreadsheets, particularly handling extension elements such as data bars and parsing related XML configuration. It contains methods for generating UUIDs, parsing XML elements, and managing conditional formatting rule properties.

classes.name: ConditionalFormattingRuleExtension
classes.description: A class representing an extension of conditional formatting rules, specifically for handling data bars in spreadsheet conditional formatting, with methods for XML parsing and manipulation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the rule with optional ID and rule type, generating a UUID if ID is not provided.

methods.name: generateUuid
methods.description: Generates a UUID string for identifying the conditional formatting rule extension.

methods.name: parseExtLstXml
methods.description: Parses an XML list element to extract and construct conditional formatting rule extensions based on data bar attributes.

methods.name: parseExtDataBarAttributesFromXml
methods.description: Parses data bar attributes from an XML element and applies them to a ConditionalDataBarExtension object.

methods.name: parseExtDataBarElementChildrenFromXml
methods.description: Parses child elements within data bar XML to configure properties such as colors and conditional format values.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of this conditional formatting rule extension.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of this conditional formatting rule extension.

methods.name: getCfRule
methods.description: Returns the conditional format rule type.

methods.name: setCfRule
methods.description: Sets the conditional format rule type.

methods.name: getSqref
methods.description: Returns the sequence of references as a string.
